review_reasons: Requires new mathematics: A rigorous categorical framework connecting information-theoretic redundancy measures to operational definitions of classicality. Specifically: (1) A category-theoretic formulation of quantum-to-classical transitions that preserves compositional structure, (2) Rigorous mathematical definitions of 'classical behavior' and 'objectivity' in terms of information-theoretic quantities, (3) A formal framework for limits of infinite environmental degrees of freedom that avoids mathematical pathologies
